# claude-voice

> Claude Code reads its answers aloud, locally, in a voice you choose. A local
> Qwen-TTS model does the speaking: no cloud, no API key, no account, and no
> audio leaving the machine. Windows only, Python standard library only.

How it works: an engine process keeps one talker model warm behind a small HTTP
API on localhost. It follows Claude Code's own session transcripts on disk, so it
needs no hooks and no cooperation from the client. A long answer is read as its
TL;DR; a short one is read in full. Two voices ship with it, Abby and Max, and
new ones are cloned from a 20-40 second recording of one person talking.

Languages: English and Russian are tested and both sound right, including
Russian read by a voice cloned from English. The model is multilingual and the
text pipeline is script-agnostic, so most other languages are expected to work.
A less widely spoken language may be mistaken for the bigger one it shares an
alphabet with: Bulgarian reads fluently but in a Russian accent.

## Pages

- [Hear the voices](https://traxdata313.github.io/claude-voice/): samples of Abby and Max, playable.
- [Repository](https://github.com/TraxData313/claude-voice): the code, and the README.

## Documentation

- [Install](https://github.com/TraxData313/claude-voice/blob/main/docs/install.md): one command, and why none of it needs administrator rights.
- [Commands](https://github.com/TraxData313/claude-voice/blob/main/docs/commands.md): every command, generated from the tool itself.
- [How it works](https://github.com/TraxData313/claude-voice/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md): the engine, the transcript watcher, and the JNI bridge into an app with no CLI.
- [The panel](https://github.com/TraxData313/claude-voice/blob/main/docs/panel-plan.md): the floating window that shows what is being said, and what changed while building it.
- [Writing for the ear](https://github.com/TraxData313/claude-voice/blob/main/docs/writing-for-the-ear.md): the TL;DR contract, and why captions sound wrong read aloud.
- [When it goes quiet](https://github.com/TraxData313/claude-voice/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): silence has no error message, so start here.
- [Voices](https://github.com/TraxData313/claude-voice/blob/main/docs/voices.md): what may be published, and what may only be kept.
